items.name: Bekubes Paseo San Luis 2022
items.information:
**Bekubes Paseo San Luis 2022** será la segunda competencia oficial despues de la pandemia en el país.

Nuestra prioridad es garantizar la seguridad y el bienestar de nuestros competidores y organizadores durante el desarrollo de la competencia de speedcubing. Por este motivo, es necesario cumplir con todos los protocolos establecidos por el gobierno y las autoridades sanitarias de Costa Rica y por la WCA.

El uso de mascarilla es obligatorio en todo momento dentro de la competencia.
Se recomienda llevar más de una mascarilla en caso de ser necesario o bien para hacer un recambio.
_____
**English version**

**Bekubes Paseo San Luis 2022** will be the second official competition after the pandemic in the country.

Our priority is to ensure the safety and well-being of our competitors and staff during the development of the speedcubing competition. For this reason, it is necessary to comply with all the protocols established by the government and health authorities of Costa Rica and by the WCA.

The use of a mask is mandatory at all times within the competition.
We reccomend bringing more than one face mask.

items.name: Please Be Quiet Colorado 2022

venue.name: Our Lady of Fatima Catholic School
venue.details: Follow signs to the cafeteria on the first floor

items.information:
### This is not a regular speedsolving competition and it does NOT feature speedsolving events. The competition will instead feature blindfolded and fewest moves events. We do not recommend this competition for newer competitors, but all are welcome. 

### If you are interested in normal speedsolving events, please look into other competitions in this area, and stay tuned for future announcements

We are enforcing the following COVID regulations
* Masks are recommended to be worn at the competition
* You may only bring one guest maximum. We are heavily discouraging spectating due to the events not being spectator friendly.
* Outside spectators are not permitted. 

These restrictions may strengthen if local mandates are enforced or if cases rise. Please check back frequently.
Please view our Competitor Responsibilities and COVID Safety tab before registering. 

### *By signing up, you agree to contribute throughout the entirety of the competition due to the small size*.

items.name: Odd Seattle Summer 2022

venue.name: [Husky Union Building](https://hub.washington.edu/) - University of Washington
venue.address: 4001 E Stevens Way NE, Seattle, WA 98195
venue.details: The competition will take place in the Lyceum (Room 160).

items.information:
This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/OddSeattleSummer2022#18271-competitor-responsibilities) tab. Please also be sure to review the [Health and Safety](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/OddSeattleSummer2022#18272-health-and-safety) tab to check additional COVID-19 requirements for this competition.

Join our [Facebook group](https://www.facebook.com/groups/159856602085) to hear about competitions in the Pacific Northwest before they're announced and keep in touch with cubers in the area!

[![Image description](https://scontent-sea1-1.xx.fbcdn.net/v/t39.30808-6/274121119_10228454031914531_4944819423112613373_n.png?stp=dst-jpg&_nc_cat=110&ccb=1-5&_nc_sid=8631f5&_nc_ohc=oKBGh7KSlKkAX94bJRA&_nc_ht=scontent-sea1-1.xx&oh=00_AT9nAvoePLh3XnW-v1qmhPs3l7K1gWv_eUh3EMhoY36NwA&oe=62637CAC)](https://www.facebook.com/groups/159856602085)

This is a competition in a series with [School's Out PLU 2022](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SchoolsOutPLU2022). You can only register for one of these two competitions. Attempting to register for multiple competitions in this series will result in the organization team choosing which registration is valid on your behalf.

items.name: Country Roads Huntington 2022
items.information:
This competition takes place at a hotel, with which we have reserved a block of rooms at a discounted rate. To book, visit [this page](https://www.hilton.com/en/hotels/htsdtdt-doubletree-huntington/) and enter the code **RCC** under Special Rates -> Group code. We have the block reserved for the night of Friday, May 27th with two queen beds for $105 (normally $144) with breakfast included.

The deadline to book under the discounted rate is Friday, May 13th. Do not book accommodation until you are a confirmed competitor (you see your name on the Competitors list).

---

First-time competitors should be present for the new competitors tutorial at 8:00 AM.
